{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue_float'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = sales_clean[sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of loyal customers who converted
n_loyal = len(loyal_customers)
n_converted_loyal = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_loyal = n_converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print results
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customers: {n_converted_loyal}")
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers: {conversion_rate_loyal}")"}
